author: Joltz_
body:
I've been wondering, Should we have more things in the shop?
Like, maybe bring back Pets, Maybe exclusive Disguises, Exclusive Badges? Prehaps a special currency like, Super Credits, Which can buy stuff like Fireworks or an Ender Dragon Disguise etc. etc.

Any other opinions?
